The remaining issue is CITADELLE_CATEGORIES type slugs mismatch with backend LISTING_TYPES. After main agent fixes slugs in citadelleConstants.js, retest the type filter on /citadelle/annonces. auth_race_condition.root_cause: CitadelleAuthProvider uses useState with initial null values and an async useEffect to load from localStorage. Pages using navigate() for auth redirect ran their useEffect during the initial render cycle when isAuthenticated=false (before the async effect completed). CitadelleCreateListing.js avoided this by rendering a lock screen instead of navigating, while CitadelleMyListings.js and CitadelleEditListing.js both used navigate() immediately.
auth_race_condition.mitigation: Added loading state check (authLoading from context) before performing auth redirect in useEffect hooks.
auth_race_condition.reproduction: 1. Have a valid citadelle_token in localStorage. 2. Navigate directly to /citadelle/espace-membre/mes-annonces. 3. Page briefly renders then redirects to /citadelle/connexion.

type_filter_mismatch.root_cause: CITADELLE_CATEGORIES array in citadelleConstants.js was defined with French-inspired slugs ('site-vitrine', 'application', 'reseaux-sociaux') while backend LISTING_TYPES uses English technical terms ('website', 'webapp', 'social_account'). Only 'ecommerce' and 'saas' accidentally match.
type_filter_mismatch.mitigation: Align CITADELLE_CATEGORIES slugs in citadelleConstants.js with backend LISTING_TYPES, OR add mapping in frontend before sending to API.
